description: A Lalit variant that admits Pa while keeping the paired Ma color. It is recognized by m M m G and the contrast of Pa with Lalit phrases.
aaroh: N. r G m M P d N S'
avroh: S' N d P M m G r S
patterns: N. r G m M m G
m M P d N d P
S' N d P M m
G m M m G r
d N S' N d P
similar: Lalit: Lalit Pancham uses Pa explicitly, while Lalit usually omits Pa.
avoid: Avoid making Pa the central nyas; the Lalit paired Ma remains primary.

name: Jait Kalyan
description: A Kalyan-ang raga with Jait-like sparseness. It is recognized by the Kalyan tivra Ma color and vakra descent rather than by a plain Yaman scale.
aaroh: S R G M P N S'
avroh: S' N D P M G R S
pakad: P N S' N D P

G M P N S' N
S' N D P M G
P M G R S N.
R G M P M G
similar: Yaman: Jait Kalyan is more pentatonic and sparse in ascent, while Yaman commonly uses D and the full N. R G M D N ascent.
avoid: Avoid plain scalar Yaman runs that overemphasize Dha in ascent.

name: Devgiri Bilawal
description: A Bilawal-family raga with a bright morning character. It is recognized by Bilawal swaras with vakra phrases that differentiate it from Alhaiya Bilawal.
aaroh: S R G m P D N S'
avroh: S' N D P m G R S
patterns: G m P D N D P

similar: Alhaiya Bilawal: Devgiri Bilawal is more direct and avoids Alhaiya's characteristic komal Ni touch.
avoid: Avoid komal Ni phrases associated with Alhaiya Bilawal unless a source explicitly gives them.

name: Kukubh Bilawal
description: A Bilawal variant with distinctive vakra turns. It is recognized by the use of G R G and a curved upper descent rather than plain Bilawal movement.
aaroh: S R G m P D N S'
avroh: S' N D P m G R S

similar: Bilawal: Kukubh Bilawal uses more vakra G R G and D N D P phrases than the parent scale.

name: Sughrai
description: A Kanada-ang raga with a grave, vakra descent. It is recognized by komal Ga and Ni, Pa-centered movement, and the Kanada phrase g m R S.
aaroh: S R g m P D n S'
avroh: S' n D P m g m R S
patterns: P D n S' n D P
m P D n D P
P m g m R S
g m R S n. S
n. S R g m P
similar: Darbari Kanada: Sughrai is lighter and more Pa-centered; Darbari has deeper andolan on komal Ga and Dha.
avoid: Avoid straight fast scalar taans that erase the Kanada curve.

name: Khat
description: A compound raga associated with Todi ang. It is recognized by komal Re, Ga, and Dha with tivra Ma and by vakra phrases that avoid a plain Todi scale.
aaroh: S r g M P d N S'
avroh: S' N d P M g r S
patterns: r g M P d P
M P d N d P
S' N d P M g
N. S r g M g
similar: Miyan ki Todi: Khat keeps a more compound vakra identity, while Miyan ki Todi emphasizes the canonical Todi andolan and chalan.
avoid: Avoid plain scalar Todi runs without vakra phrases.

name: Lachari Todi
description: A Todi-family raga with a plaintive character. It is recognized by Todi swaras and vakra descent, with Pa treated lightly or by tradition.
aaroh: S r g M d N S'
avroh: S' N d P M g r S
patterns: r g M d N d
S' N d P M g
g M d M g r
N. S r g M g
d N S' N d P
similar: Gurjari Todi: Lachari Todi is more vakra and selective in ascent; Gurjari Todi often omits Pa and Dha in ascent.
avoid: Avoid stabilizing Pa in ascent unless following a documented version.
